# vector spec run

Emit a contract's test and run it.

## Usage

```text
vector spec run <contract.json> [flags]
```

## Arguments

<scalar-field name="&lt;contract.json&gt;" required>

the contract

</scalar-field>

## Flags

<scalar-field name="-o, --out" type="&lt;file&gt;">

where to keep the test (default: a temporary file)

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--spec" type="&lt;file&gt;">

the source the contract quotes, RFC XML v3 or plain text (default: found next to the contract)

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--nish-root" type="&lt;dir&gt;">

a nish checkout: finds the module and the compiler

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--nish" type="&lt;bin&gt;">

the nish compiler (default: nish)

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--format" type="&lt;f&gt;">

text (default), markdown (a PR comment) or json

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--package" type="&lt;pkg&gt;">

a package of your own, &lt;name&gt;=&lt;dir&gt;: modules &lt;name&gt;/&lt;path&gt; are &lt;dir&gt;/&lt;path&gt;.ts, .py in python, .rs in rust, .go in go (repeatable) May be given more than once.

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--lang" type="&lt;id&gt;">

the test's language: nish (default), python, rust, go or typescript

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--harness" type="&lt;h&gt;">

standalone (default), or the test framework the test plugs into: pytest for python, cargo for rust, gotest for go, node for typescript

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="-h, --help">

Show this command's help, and exit 0.

</scalar-field>

## Exit codes

See [exit codes](../command-line.md#exit-codes) for what each status means.
